notes: All 12 views inspected. Ribbed steel boxcar with a curved cream roof and running board, vertical body ribs, a sliding door with track and handle on each side, end ladders and grab irons, a brake wheel on one end, buffers and couplers, and two bogies with brake gear. The underside is a complete underframe with cross-bearers. Doors are modelled closed on both sides. No reporting marks or logos.
limitations: Stylised Cozy-kit palette rather than photoreal materials.
The sliding doors and wheels are fused into the body mesh and cannot be opened or rolled without separation.
method: Visual inspection of local-model renders and technical reports
